test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some pins are needles.

II. All pins are nails.

III. All needles are screws.

**Conclusions:**

I. No nail is a screw.

II. Some needles are nails.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statement:

I. Some pins are needles.

II. All pins are nails.

III. All needles are screws.

The Most possible venn diagram which can be drawn is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca8f998c5aedaa1e6df681a339391eea1d3fbc4316c9b52134e2b7a211c276b5.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No nail is a screw - False (Because no such conclusion cannot be drawn from the

statements)

**II. Some needles are nails - True (Because It is given in the statement)**

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 4"**
